claims.class_margins: NOT_MEASURED here (diagnostic-only quantities need native canonical scoring)
claims.existing_accuracy_context: Parent Adam52 18/24, A54 16/24, B54 16/24 (DEV24, previously explored, unchanged)

centering.limitation: Matched cohorts are individually centered; same-image fallback baselines overlap them, so the summed advantage is generally nonzero. Deliberately NOT recentered (that would be another candidate).

compute.note: Counts a native GSPO step WOULD need (one backward per admitted response); nothing here is executed.

definitions.format_share: sum w|format part| / sum w(|acc|+|format|+|overlong|+|unexplained|) relative to each response's OWN baseline set; a coefficient-mass descriptor, NOT a variance or gradient share

label_indicator_projection.label: RESPONSE_LABEL_INDICATOR_COEFFICIENT_PROJECTION: sums of w*A (or w*A/L) over sampled responses, projected onto response-label indicators 1[answer] and 1[image]x1[answer]. These are NOT parameter-gradient parts and NOT even a literal bias-parameter gradient: a score-function gradient also carries the policy normalizer -E_policy[feature], which matters whenever the per-image advantage sum is nonzero (results/GROUP_RELATIVE_SYNTHETIC_SCORE_NORMALIZER_COUNTEREXAMPLE_V1.json: zero answer-indicator projection with nonzero bias and image-feature score gradients). Not a margin or accuracy.

criteria.Q1_sign: C: zero WRONG_VALID_POSITIVE and zero CORRECT_NEGATIVE among admitted MRI responses with nonzero advantage
criteria.Q2_format: C format share of absolute baseline-split mass strictly below the actual Paired (B) plan on the same responses
criteria.Q3_hard_modality: at least one MRI image whose Direct same-image group is inactive receives nonzero C credit, and every format-valid credited response there is sign-correct
criteria.Q4_correctness_alignment: C point-biserial(correct, A) among admitted format-valid MRI >= the actual Paired (B) plan (None fails)
criteria.not_criteria: More admitted groups/responses is NOT a success criterion; DEV/final100/new16 are never consulted.
criteria.rule: Any failure -> REJECT_C_BEFORE_GPU. All pass -> INCONCLUSIVE_CPU_COEFFICIENT_ONLY (never GO: margins/VJPs/accuracy unmeasured).

decision.meaning: C passes the predeclared scalar coefficient descriptors on the exact Common32 responses only (Q1 largely by construction; C is an action-dependent changed estimator without global centering). Gradient direction, canonical class margins and accuracy remain NOT_MEASURED; the most that may follow is ONE separately scoped read-only VJP check after independent review and fresh human permission. Not training, not GO replication.

common32_matched_A_B_C.label: EXACT_MATCHED: Parent Adam52, identical 32 responses/tokens/images/rewards/exposure; only the advantage plan differs

changed_jointly_vs_B: baseline set: parsed-label-matched across images, else same-image fallback
scale: SD of the pair's 8 rewards (B: SD of each K4 half-split group)
admission: one inherited gate on the pair's 8 grades (B: one gate per K4 group)
intervention.estimator: ACTION_DEPENDENT_CHANGED_SURROGATE: baseline depends on the sampled label; expected score gradient changes
intervention.global_centering: NOT_GUARANTEED: matched sets centered, overlapping same-image fallbacks are not; signed sums reported, not recentered
intervention.label_matching: parsed canonical class label only; full text/reasoning prefix/length NOT held fixed; no visual causality identified

limitations: Counterfactual advantage plan on authenticated saved TRAIN responses; not historical training and not new on-policy sampling.
Action-dependent baseline changes the expected estimator. Correctness-sign and correlation criteria are partly by construction, not independent learning evidence.
Pair8 scale, pair admission and baseline/fallback change together; one versioned advantage-plan treatment, not isolated baseline causal evidence.
No per-response or margin VJP, native C gradient, finite Adam step, image-grounding or new accuracy measured.
Historical DEV24 is explored internal development evidence only.
